name: tinysearch (Local WASM Static-Site Search)
free_limit: Open-source Rust indexer and WebAssembly client-side full-text search for static websites; MIT or Apache-2.0 dual license with no software query or index quota.
watch_out: Build and host the search index and WASM assets yourself; website/CDN bandwidth and CI build resources are not included. It is not a managed hosted search API.
